data.title: Ford Sales Slide 6.6% After Model Phase-Outs
data.description: Ford Q3 U.S. vehicle sales fell 6.6% to 509,764 units due to Escape & Corsair phase-outs. F-Series lead and hybrid sales set records.

data.description: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest ETFs have poured over $41M into Rocket Lab, betting on the space company’s growth and Neutron rocket.
